en.headline: Hong Kong tops Asian cities internationality index, widening lead on Singapore
en.dek: The General Chamber of Commerce scored the city 74.6 out of 100, two points ahead of Singapore, in its second annual ranking of 11 Asian cities.
body: Hong Kong remained Asia’s most international city in the Hong Kong General Chamber of Commerce’s 2026 Asian Cities Internationality Index, scoring 74.6 out of 100, up from 73.7 last year. Singapore stayed second on 72.6, leaving a two-point gap compared with 0.2 points a year earlier.

The chamber commissioned Ipsos to assess 11 cities on seven areas covering 119 indicators. Researchers surveyed more than 1,100 local and expatriate business executives. Hong Kong kept first place in business and economy, with 78.6 points, and rose from fourth to third in innovation and ideas. It ranked second in quality of life, infrastructure and connectivity, and human capital diversity, third in government and legal systems for business, and fourth in cultural interaction.

Seoul climbed to third on 69.2 points, overtaking Tokyo on 68.6. Shanghai was fifth on 65.3, followed by Bangkok, Kuala Lumpur and Taipei. Chamber chairman Jacob Kam Chak-pui said the result reflected the city’s resilience, world-class infrastructure, open business environment and the “one country, two systems” framework. He added that Hong Kong still had room to improve in innovation, cultural interaction and the legal environment for business.

zh.headline: 總商會國際化指數港蟬聯亞洲第一 領先新加坡拉開至兩分
zh.dek: 香港總商會公布2026年亞洲城市國際化指數，本港獲74.6分居首，較新加坡高兩分，領先幅度較去年擴大。
body: 香港總商會公布第二年《亞洲城市國際化指數》，香港以74.6分蟬聯11個亞洲城市之首，高於去年的73.7分。新加坡維持第二，獲72.6分，兩地差距由去年的0.2分擴大至兩分。
指數由總商會委託益普索編製，按商業與經濟、生活質素、基建與聯通、創新與創意、人力資本多樣性、文化互動，以及政府與商業法律制度七個範疌、119項指標評分，並訪問逾1,100名本地及外籍商界行政人員。香港在商業與經濟維持第一，創新與創意由第四升至第三；生活質素、基建與聯通及人力資本多樣性均排第二，政府與商業法律制度排第三，文化互動排第四。
首爾以69.2分升上第三，東京以68.6分跌至第四，上海65.3分排第五，其後為曼谷、吉隆坡及台北。總商會主席金澤培表示，排名反映本港韌性，有賴世界級基建、開放營商環境及「一國兩制」優勢，同時認為創新、文化互動及營商法律制度仍有進步空間。
